snippet.title: Moraff's Pinball - another bad pinball game
snippet.description:
Now, something like this would have passed in 1979, but in 1989? No go. This game reminds me of what a pinball game would've been like on an Apple II or Atari 2600 or something, not an IBM PC in the late-1980s. :(

The sound effects sound like they came out of an old Atari 2600, too.

(Apparently the video got messed up either in the conversion or the upload... I'll look into it when I have the chance.)
